full_details: At the lodging, Ambrose Kettleby called from Somerset House, sent up for his lord's linen and letters. My lord is with the court in Surrey. He has heard the house is open. He would know that it opened quietly, and when the new king is to be seen. He will come unlooked-for, on Thursday the second of October, and Kettleby wrote the day down. The Lord Treasurer cannot stir hand nor foot, nor feed himself, and every paper that wants his hand is waiting on his foot. My lord bids you keep an orderly house. You said the orderliest in Middlesex. In the afternoon the play was Two Gentlemen. After it, you gave the call to Bryan and Heminges. Bryan said what nobody had put in Kettleby's mouth: an old man who cannot hold a pen, two younger men waiting to hold it, and a play about a weak king and his favourites. Heminges said you play it as licensed. Nobody added anything.
one_sentence: Kettleby called from Somerset House, my lord will come unlooked-for on the second of October, and Heminges said you play the king as licensed.
title: Heard my lord will come unlooked-for on the second of October
